name: Tokita Kanami
source:
Favorite food: Tokoroten

The new emperor appointed to the empire by the Albright Republic after the war, though she has no blood ties with the royal family. She’s also the (non-blood-related) sister of the protagonist, but she doesn’t know whether he’s still alive or not.
